title: 第25章 满足，热闹
novel_title: 1960：九个妹妹把我宠上天(天下第九)
content_zh: “待会大伙使劲吃，不够吃再放肉。”辰楠擦拭着手上的油脂，看着锅里的肉一脸满意。这次应该够大伙吃一顿的，不够就继续加，咱有肉怕啥。“别别别，肯定够吃了。”奶奶赶紧出声制止，她真怕辰楠继续往锅里添肉。四哥建民还上前把辰楠拉到了一旁，不让他靠近灶台。辰楠笑了笑，“还剩半头猪，一半留在爷奶这里给我妹妹们吃，剩下的一半建设哥带回去给大伯。”也不知道大伯去公社开会什么时候回来，可能赶不上这次杀猪宴。本来剩下的猪肉他是想着全部都给大伯的。但妹妹们在爷爷这里吃住，得留点给妹妹们吃。“这怎么行，我们就不带回去了。”建设拒绝，“待会给你大伯端一碗回去就行。”辰建设实在是不好意思再拿肉，他们人数太多了。其余人也不敢打包带肉回去，毕竟这刚煮了半头猪，他们的脸皮没那么厚。“你们都听我的，否则这些野猪肉就全扔掉。”“或者下次再捡到野猪就不喊你们了。”辰楠强硬了些，否则这些野猪肉还真送不出去。众人一听要扔掉野猪肉，那肯定是不舍得，只能接受辰楠的好，等以后有机会再回报他。至于下次再捡野猪，他们也就一笑而过。能捡到一次野猪已是万幸，下次还想捡，几乎是不可能的事。爷爷这时站了出来，看向众人，表情变得严肃起来。“这个年代很多人都在饿肚子，能把肉拿出来分给你们吃的都是至亲！”“甚至有些至亲都不会这样做，或者说是做不到小楠这般。”“你们可要记住小楠对你们的好，以后在小楠有需要的时候，你们在能力范围内也要帮助他！知道了吗？”爷爷的话振聋发聩，响彻在院子里。“知道了爷爷！”“知道了太爷爷！”辰建设等人与一群小孩都齐声回应着。院子里很热闹，叽叽喳喳个不停。偶尔院子外有人路过，见这里如此热闹都想看看怎么回事。敲门想要进入，都被辰建设打发掉，声称是辰楠从城里归来，大伙正在给他接风洗尘呢。半个小时后。大锅里的猪肉被煮得沸腾。肉香渐渐弥漫开来，那是一种久违的、令人心醉的香味。也就这地方稍微偏僻了一些，否则早就有很多人来围观。在这缺粮的年月，有肉已经是难得的美味。一次性煮半头猪更是从未出现过的事情。在众人的闲聊中。一大锅下水与猪肉终于煮好。“真香啊！”侄儿大壮凑到锅边，深深吸了一口气，差点把口水滴进锅里。二嫂笑骂着拍开他：“你个皮猴子，离远点，别把口水掉进去了。”香气十足的肉被盛到几个大盆里。院子里摆开了几张矮桌，二十几个围坐在一起，眼睛都盯着盆里的肉，喉结上下滚动着。但长辈还未动筷子，其他人可不敢先动筷，都眼巴巴地看着爷奶二人。“好东西。”爷爷先动了筷子，夹起一块猪肝，吹了吹，送进嘴里。他闭上眼睛，细细咀嚼着，脸上的皱纹都舒展开来。“香，真香！”他喃喃道，声音有些哽咽。这话像是发令枪，大家纷纷伸出筷子。起初还有些拘谨，但很快就不顾形象地抢食起来。肉太香了，太久没尝过肉味，每个人都巴不得连舌头都吞下去。“慢点吃，别噎着。”奶奶一边提醒，一边自已也顾不上形象，吃得满嘴是油。辰楠把一小盆肉放在妹妹们面前，让她们自已动手。他自已夹了一块猪肉，放进嘴里咀嚼。“也没他们吃的那么香。”野猪肉有点柴，还有点腥味，他们怎么像是在吃绝世美味？不过他没说什么，这个年代能填饱肚子就已经比许多人强，能大口吃肉的更是少之又少，哪还能挑剔味道怎么样。一群小孩子闷头吃得最香，嘴角都沾着油，根本不想开口说话，因为说话就会少吃一块。辰楠看着眼前热闹的场景，心里暖暖的。他从来没有过这样的热闹，没有这么多家人。现在，他有了爷奶、爸妈、大伯一群亲人，这就是他在这个年代的家人，是他要守护的人。“这猪肝真嫩！”三嫂感叹道，“我都快忘了肉是啥滋味了。”四哥吃得满嘴流油，含糊不清地说：“要是天天都能这么吃，那才叫过日子呢！”“能吃上一顿都是托了辰楠的福，你还想天天吃，你脸咋就那么大呢。”四嫂白了四哥一眼，这才开始喝就敢这样想。谁不想天天吃好喝好，可事与愿违，如今谁家有吃的都烧高香了。这顿饭吃了很久，从刚开始的‘抢食’到细嚼慢咽，都舍不得让这难得的美味太快下肚。他们不记得有多久没吃饱过，这是第一次吃了个饱，甚至不少孩子都吃撑了，摸着圆滚滚的肚子直打嗝。“吃饱肚子的感觉真好，”辰大壮满足地叹了口气，“要是每顿都能如此，那简直爽翻天了。”吃饱喝足。嫂子们忙着收拾碗筷，孩子们在院子里追逐打闹。如此温馨的场景，已经很久没有过。辰楠虽然觉得野猪肉不怎么样，但这是难得的肉，他也算是吃饱了。“大哥、二哥三哥四哥，你们把剩下的肉都带回去。”“还有没吃完的也带回去，大伯还未尝试过呢。”辰楠看着锅里还有一小盆肉，以及早已切成一块块的野猪肉。“这个，我们就不拿了吧？”辰建设有些犹豫，这又吃又拿的，会不会吃相太难看了？辰楠故意板着一张脸，“刚才说好的，赶紧拿回去。”“那就谢谢小楠了。”大嫂拿出带来的布袋子，把肉装进去，脸上满是感激。二嫂三嫂四嫂她们在一旁帮忙，如今她们还未分家。这可是肉啊！“爷奶，谢谢你们，也谢谢小楠，这肉能让家里撑不少日子。”奶奶笑着摆手：“都是一家人，谢啥？现在这年月，大家都难，互相帮衬着才好。”闲聊几句。几个嫂子带着年纪小的孩子回家。她们把大部分的肉都留给了二老，顺带帮忙腌制好，只拿了小部分肉回家。
content_en: "Everyone eat hard later. If there is not enough food, add more meat." Chen Nan wiped the grease on his hands and looked at the meat in the pot with a satisfied expression.This time should be enough for everyone to have a meal. If it’s not enough, just keep adding more. We have meat, so what’s the point?"No, no, no, there must be enough to eat." Grandma quickly stopped her. She was really afraid that Chen Nan would continue to add meat to the pot.Fourth brother Jianmin also stepped forward and pulled Chen Nan aside, preventing him from getting close to the stove.Chen Nan smiled and said, "There is half a pig left. Half of it is left with grandma for my sisters to eat. Brother Jianshe takes the remaining half back to the uncle." I don't know when the uncle will come back from the commune meeting. He may not be able to catch up with the pig killing feast.Originally, he wanted to give all the remaining pork to his uncle.But the younger sisters have to live and eat at Grandpa's place, so they have to leave some food for the younger sisters."This is okay, we won't take it back." Jianshe refused, "I'll just bring a bowl back to your uncle later." Chen Jianshe was really embarrassed to take any more meat, there were too many of them.The rest of the people didn't dare to pack up the meat and go back. After all, half of the pig had just been cooked, and they were not that thick-skinned."You all listen to me, otherwise all the wild boar meat will be thrown away." "Maybe I won't call you when I pick up a wild boar next time." Chen Nan was a little tougher, otherwise the wild boar meat would really not be given away.When everyone heard that they wanted to throw away the wild boar meat, they would definitely be reluctant to do so. They could only accept Chen Nan's kindness and repay him when they have the opportunity in the future.As for picking up wild boars next time, they would just laugh it off.It is lucky to pick up a wild boar once. It is almost impossible to pick up a wild boar next time.Grandpa stood up at this time, looked at everyone, and his expression became serious."Many people are hungry in this era, and those who can share meat with you are close relatives!" "There are even some close relatives who won't do this, or they can't do what Xiaonan is like." "You must remember Xiaonan's kindness to you, and when Xiaonan is in need in the future, you must also help him within your ability within your ability! Do you understand?" Grandpa's words were deafening and resounded in the yard."I know, grandpa!" "I know, grandpa!" Chen Jianshe, others and a group of children responded in unison.The yard was very lively, chattering non-stop.Occasionally, people pass by outside the yard and want to see what's going on when the place is so busy.Knocking on the door and trying to get in, Chen Jianshe dismissed them all, claiming that Chen Nan had returned from the city and everyone was waiting for him to cleanse himself.Half an hour later.The pork in the cauldron was boiling.The aroma of meat gradually spread, it was a long-lost and intoxicating aroma.This place is a little remote, otherwise many people would have come to watch.In these years of food shortage, meat is already a rare delicacy.Cooking half a pig at once has never happened before.In everyone's chat.A large pot of water and pork is finally cooked."It smells so good!" My nephew leaned over to the pot, took a deep breath, and almost drooled into the pot.The second sister-in-law laughed and scolded him and slapped him away: "You silly monkey, stay away, don't drop your saliva in it." The fragrant meat was put into several large basins.Several low tables were set up in the yard, and more than twenty people sat together, staring at the meat in the basin, with their Adam's apple rolling up and down.But before the elders moved their chopsticks, the others didn't dare to move their chopsticks first, and they all looked at the grandma and grandpa eagerly."Good stuff." Grandpa moved his chopsticks first, picked up a piece of pork liver, blew on it, and put it into his mouth.He closed his eyes and chewed carefully, relaxing the wrinkles on his face."Smells, it smells so good!" He murmured, his voice choked with sobs.These words were like a starting gun, and everyone stretched out their chopsticks.At first I was a little reserved, but soon I started grabbing food regardless of the image.The meat was so fragrant. It had been so long since they had tasted meat. Everyone wanted to swallow it with their tongues."Eat slowly, don't choke." Grandma reminded her, but she didn't care about her image and ate with her mouth full of oil.Chen Nan placed a small pot of meat in front of the sisters and asked them to do it themselves.He picked up a piece of pork and put it in his mouth to chew."It's not as delicious as what they eat." The wild boar meat is a bit woody and has a fishy smell. Why do they seem to be eating a unique delicacy?But he didn't say anything. In this era, being able to fill your stomach is already better than many people. There are even fewer people who can eat meat in large quantities, so how can they be picky about the taste.A group of children ate the most delicious food with their heads down. The corners of their mouths were stained with oil. They did not want to speak at all, because if they spoke, they would eat less.Chen Nan looked at the lively scene in front of him and felt warm in his heart.He has never had such a lively life or so many family members.Now, he has grandparents, parents, uncles and a group of relatives. These are his family in this era, and they are the people he wants to protect."This pork liver is so tender!" The third sister-in-law sighed, "I almost forgot what the meat tastes like." The fourth brother's mouth was full of oil after eating, and he said vaguely: "If you can eat like this every day, that would be a living!" "It's all thanks to Chen Nan that I can eat this meal. Why do you have such a big face if you want to eat it every day?" The fourth sister-in-law rolled her eyes at the fourth brother, and then she started to drink.Who doesn't want to eat and drink well every day, but it backfires. Nowadays, everyone who has food to eat is highly incense.It took a long time to eat this meal. From the initial 'grabbing' to chewing slowly, I couldn't bear to let this rare delicacy go down too quickly.They couldn't remember how long it had been since they had eaten enough. This was the first time they had eaten enough. Many of the children were so full that they felt their round bellies and burped."It feels so good to have a full stomach," Chen Dazhuang sighed contentedly, "If every meal could be like this, it would be amazing." After eating and drinking.The sisters-in-law were busy clearing away the dishes, while the children were chasing each other in the yard.Such a warm scene has not happened for a long time.Although Chen Nan felt that wild boar meat was not very good, it was rare meat and he was full."Eldest brother, second brother, third brother and fourth brother, you guys take back the rest of the meat." "Take back what you haven't finished eating. My uncle hasn't tried it yet." Chen Nan looked at the small pot of meat in the pot, as well as the wild boar meat that had been cut into pieces."Should we not take this?" Chen Jianshe was a little hesitant. It would be too ugly to eat and take this food at the same time.Chen Nan deliberately kept a straight face, "As promised, take it back quickly." "Thank you, Xiao Nan." The sister-in-law took out the cloth bag she brought and put the meat in, her face full of gratitude.The second sister-in-law, the third sister-in-law and the fourth sister-in-law are helping. They have not yet separated.This is meat!"Grandma, thank you, and thank you Xiaonan, this meat can support the family for a long time." Grandma smiled and waved her hands: "We are all a family, why should we thank you? It is difficult for everyone these days, so we can help each other." Chat a few words.Several sisters-in-law came home with their young children.They left most of the meat to the second elder and helped marinate it, but only took a small part of the meat home.
